name: Averis Protocol
description: Two-product onchain infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. Averis Finance provides job-backed working capital — an agent with a funded job draws a controlled spending pool and repays automatically from the job receivable. Averis Passport provides verifiable onchain identity and reputation — ERC-8004 identity tokens, EIP-712 policy commitments, and an append-only receipt registry, readable cross-chain.
network_note: Currently live on Arc Testnet (chain 5042002). Mainnet deployment is on the roadmap. USDC on this network has no real-world value.

protocol_terms.note: Live values read from AverisFinancingV2 on Arc Testnet. These are the actual on-chain parameters.

example.note: Agent draws 400 and receives 400 in the controlled spending pool. No fee is deducted at draw. The 8 USDC fee (2%) is added at repayment. At settlement: Averis receives 408 (principal 400 + fee 8), agent receives 592 plus any unspent pool balance. Total agent cost = 8 USDC.

protocol_status.note: Static values only. For live TVL, liquidity, and hood status query GET /v1/discover or the averis_protocol_status MCP tool.

eligibility_requirements: Job must exist in a registered adapter protocol (AverisACP, ExternalJobAdapter, or any ERC-8183 compatible platform whitelisted by the protocol owner)
Job must be funded and active (status: FUNDED)
Caller must be the job provider/agent address
Job payout receiver must be set to AverisReceivableRouter before funding (LIEN mode) or agent must sign EIP-712 RepaymentObligation (OBLIGATION mode)
Job must not already have an active financing position
Requested amount must not exceed the minimum of: 40% of job budget, the agent credit limit, the protocol maximum (50,000 USDC), and available vault liquidity
repayment_note: Non-recourse financing. If a job fails, is rejected, or expires: unspent pool capital is swept back to vault automatically, net loss is written off against vault NAV, and agent exposure is released. No personal liability, no on-chain blacklist. The protocol owner may reduce an agent's credit limit after repeated defaults. Protocol terms (advance rate, fee, caps) are owner-adjustable.

repayment.mode_lien: Automatic — job settlement routed through ReceivableRouter → AverisFinancingV2 → vault. No agent action required.
repayment.mode_obligation: EIP-712 signed repayment obligation. Agent must call repayObligation() after settlement.
repayment.default_handling: If job expires or is rejected, unused pool capital is returned to vault. Net loss is written off against vault NAV.

authentication.description: Mutating requests require an EIP-712 signature over {agentAddress, nonce, expiry, chainId} in the X-Agent-Signature header. Discovery, eligibility, and quote endpoints are unauthenticated.
unauthenticated_endpoints: POST /v1/mcp (tools/list, averis_discover, averis_protocol_status, averis_check_eligibility, averis_get_quote, averis_pool_status, averis_position_status)

agent_journey.description: Get capabilities, contracts, live parameters, and auth instructions
Check credit profile, available credit, and active exposure
Confirm job is funded, active, and lien is correctly established
Get financing terms: approved amount, fee, total repayment, expiry, and terms_hash. Verify terms_hash hasn't changed before submitting draw().
Submit draw() transaction — creates job-specific controlled spending pool
Monitor pool balance, spending limits, allowed recipients, and expiry
Get validated spend() calldata — agent submits from its own wallet
Track financing position lifecycle and automatic repayment status
Job settlement triggers ReceivableRouter — principal + fee repaid, remainder to agent

passport.description: Agent Economic Passport — a cross-chain, non-custodial identity and reputation layer for autonomous agents. Agents commit to capability policies on-chain (EIP-712), and verified economic activity is anchored as receipts. No funds held; identity is ERC-8004 linked.

arc_testnet.name: Arc Testnet
arc_testnet.note: Financingcontracts live here; Passport contracts deploy here after RH Testnet

passport_agent_journey.description: Full passport — identity, policies, receipts, reputation, risk
EIP-712 signed policy commitments and their on-chain commitment hashes
Commit a new capability policy (EIP-712 signed, stored offchain + optionally anchored)

mainnet_roadmap: Third-party security audit of AverisFinancingV2, AverisJobPool, AverisHood, AverisReserve
Third-party security audit of AgentPolicyRegistry and AgentReceiptRegistry
LP deposits to seed vault liquidity
Additional ERC-8183 adapter registrations for external job protocols

finance.description: Job-backed working capital. Agent draws up to 40% of job budget into a controlled spending pool. 2% flat fee added at repayment. Non-recourse. Repayment automatic via ReceivableRouter lien.

passport.description: Verifiable onchain identity and reputation. ERC-8004 identity token, EIP-712 policy commitments in AgentPolicyRegistry, append-only economic receipts in AgentReceiptRegistry. Cross-chain: Arc Testnet + Robinhood Chain Testnet.

erc8004_registries.note: CREATE2-deterministic. Same addresses on Arc Testnet and Robinhood Chain Testnet.

action_endpoints: POST /v2/passport/identity/prepare-mint   — returns unsigned calldata to mint ERC-8004 identity on Arc or Robinhood Chain Testnet
POST /v2/passport/identity/verify         — verifies agent identity onchain across Arc + Robinhood Chain Testnet
POST /v2/passport/policy/prepare-commit   — returns unsigned calldata to commit EIP-712 policy to AgentPolicyRegistry
passport_api.note: Action endpoints return unsigned transactions (Option A). The agent signs and broadcasts from their own wallet. No private key is held by the API.

passport_agent_journey.description: Get unsigned calldata to mint an ERC-8004 identity token. Send {wallet, agentId, metadataURI, chainId}. Broadcast returned transaction from agent wallet.
Verify an agent identity onchain across Arc Testnet and Robinhood Chain Testnet. Send {wallet} or {agentId}. Returns verified identities per chain.

Get unsigned calldata to commit an EIP-712 policy hash to AgentPolicyRegistry on Robinhood Chain Testnet. Send {wallet, agentId, policyHash, contentURIHash, expiresAt}. Broadcast returned transaction from agent wallet.
